Looking at this cartoon caption contest, let me analyze the humor in each option:

The strongest candidates are:

**(C) "… and they will consider any putt that drops into their cup to be an act of war."**
- Excellent wordplay with "cup" (golf hole vs. UFO)
- Absurdist escalation from a golf problem to international incident
- Clever diplomatic/political humor
- Unexpected and layered

**(B) "Found my ball and intelligent life."**
- Nice pun on "finding" both literal and existential
- Relatively simple but effective

**(H) "They're telling me they're going to use my golf club to probe me. Get a video, it'll go viral!"**
- Combines UFO abduction tropes with social media obsession
- Absurdist and darkly humorous

**(G) "Daaaaaad the immigrants are ruining my game againnnnn"**
- Edgy political satire applying xenophobic rhetoric to aliens
- Good escalation of absurdity

Option **(C)** stands out as the funniest because it has the most sophisticated humor: it features clever wordplay, absurdist escalation, and unexpected political/diplomatic framing. The double meaning of "cup" and the escalation to treating the situation as an act of war creates multiple layers of humor that land together perfectly.

ANSWER: C
